what: Fixed table of contents link (href="#id") each time, while its target section passes the 162px line from the top of the screen, it gets is-active·aria-current — on/off only with no curve, and the color·background are changed by the consuming css over .32s (the FAQ category index paints the category currently being read with an off-white panel)

options.line: Line measured from the top of the screen (px), default 162

from.where: index.html .ew-faq__nav — original top.js: toggleClass is-active (.js-sidenav-anchor) for each .js-sidenav-target, start top top+=162 · end bottom top+=162
article.html .gb-toc__links (sticky table of contents beside the article — original fs-toc: an arrow stands before the link of the section being read)
